units.source_text: 源氏公子走进室内，看见只有一个人睡着，觉得称心。

en.t: Prince Genji entered the room and, seeing that only one person was asleep there, felt pleased.

units.source_text: 隔壁厢房地形较低，有两个侍女睡着。

en.t: The side room next door was set lower, and two serving women were asleep there.

units.source_text: 源氏公子将盖在这人身上的衣服揭开，挨近身去，觉得这人身材较大，但也并不介意。

en.t: Prince Genji lifted away the robe covering this person and drew close; he felt that the body was somewhat larger, but he did not mind.

units.source_text: 只是这个人睡得很熟，和那人显然不同，却是奇怪。

en.t: Only, this person was sleeping very deeply and was clearly different from the one he sought, which seemed strange.

units.source_text: 这时候他才知道认错了人，吃惊之余，不免懊恼。

en.t: Only then did he realize he had mistaken the person; startled, he could not help feeling vexed.

units.source_text: 他想：“教这女子知道我是认错了人，毕竟太傻；而且她也会觉得奇怪。

en.t: He thought, "It would be far too foolish to let this woman know that I mistook her for someone else; besides, she would find it strange too.

units.source_text: 倘丢开了她，出去找寻我的意中人，则此人既然如此坚决地逃避，势必毫无效果，反而受她奚落。”

en.t: If I leave her and go out to look for the woman I desire, then since that person is avoiding me so determinedly, it will surely come to nothing, and I will only be mocked by her instead."

units.source_text: 既而又想：“睡在这里的人，倘是黄昏时分灯光之下窥见的那个美人，那么势不得已，将就了吧。”

en.t: After a while he thought again, "If the person sleeping here is the beauty I glimpsed under the lamplight at dusk, then there is no help for it; I may as well make do."

units.source_text: 这真是浮薄少年的不良之心啊！

en.t: Truly, this was the wicked heart of a frivolous young man!
